title: Student Grade Analyzer
description: Build a Python program that reads student grades from a CSV, computes statistics (mean, median, pass/fail rates), and generates a simple text report.
objective: Apply Python fundamentals to a real data processing task.

milestones.title: Read CSV data with Python
Compute mean, median, highest, lowest scores
Classify students as Pass/Fail
Generate and save a formatted report

evaluationCriteria: Handles edge cases (empty files, missing values)
expectedOutput: A script that takes grades.csv and outputs a formatted analysis report.
portfolioValue: Demonstrates Python proficiency and analytical thinking.

title: College Course Registration Database
description: Design and build a relational database for a college registration system. Write SQL queries to answer business questions about enrollment, course popularity, and student performance.
objective: Apply SQL and relational database design to a realistic system.

milestones.title: Design the ER diagram (Students, Courses, Enrollment)
Create tables and insert sample data
Write analytical queries (TOP courses, average GPA by major)
Write a complex report query using JOINs and window functions

expectedOutput: A SQLite database with schema, seed data, and 5+ analytical SQL queries.
portfolioValue: Demonstrates database design and SQL query skills.

title: Exam Score Distribution Analyzer
description: Perform a complete statistical analysis of an exam dataset. Apply hypothesis testing to determine if two teaching methods produce significantly different scores.
objective: Apply descriptive and inferential statistics to draw data-driven conclusions.

milestones.title: Load dataset and compute descriptive statistics
Visualise distributions (histogram, box plot)
Perform normality test (Shapiro-Wilk)
Conduct t-test and interpret p-value
Write a 1-page findings report

expectedOutput: Jupyter notebook with statistical analysis and visualizations.
portfolioValue: Demonstrates statistical reasoning — critical for data science interviews.

title: Student Performance Predictor
description: Build a machine learning model that predicts student exam performance based on study habits, attendance, and demographics. Compare multiple algorithms and select the best.
objective: Apply the complete supervised ML pipeline on a real-world educational dataset.

milestones.title: Load and explore the dataset (EDA)
Preprocess: handle missing values, encode categories, scale features
Train Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest
Evaluate each model: accuracy, precision, recall, F1
Tune the best model with GridSearchCV
Interpret feature importance and write conclusions

evaluationCriteria: Proper evaluation metrics for the problem
expectedOutput: Jupyter notebook with trained model achieving >75% accuracy on test set.
portfolioValue: Classic ML project — expected in every data science/ML portfolio.

title: Movie Recommendation System
description: Build a collaborative filtering recommendation system using matrix factorisation. Implement both user-based and item-based approaches.
objective: Understand recommender systems — used by Netflix, YouTube, and Spotify.

milestones.title: Load MovieLens dataset and explore rating patterns
Implement user-based collaborative filtering
Implement item-based collaborative filtering
Implement matrix factorization (SVD)
Evaluate using RMSE and generate top-N recommendations
Build a simple CLI interface

expectedOutput: A recommendation system CLI that takes a user ID and returns top-10 movie recommendations.
portfolioValue: Recommender systems are asked about in virtually every ML engineer interview.

title: Image Classifier (CIFAR-10)
description: Build a Convolutional Neural Network to classify images into 10 categories (CIFAR-10 dataset). Apply transfer learning with a pre-trained ResNet model.
objective: Master CNNs and transfer learning — the core of computer vision.

milestones.title: Load and preprocess CIFAR-10, visualise samples
Build and train a custom CNN from scratch
Apply transfer learning with pre-trained ResNet18
Compare accuracy: scratch vs. transfer learning
Visualise filters and activation maps

expectedOutput: Trained model with inference demo showing predictions on new images.
portfolioValue: CNN + transfer learning is the foundation of all computer vision applications.

title: AI Career Mentor Chatbot
description: Build a RAG-based (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) career mentor chatbot that answers questions about AI careers using a knowledge base of job descriptions and skills.
objective: Implement a production-grade LLM application using modern AI engineering patterns.

milestones.title: Prepare knowledge base (career docs, job descriptions)
Implement text chunking and embedding generation
Set up vector store (FAISS or ChromaDB)
Implement retrieval + LLM generation pipeline
Build a FastAPI backend and simple chat UI

evaluationCriteria: Retrieves relevant context for career questions
expectedOutput: A running chatbot with web interface that answers career questions using the knowledge base.
portfolioValue: RAG applications are the #1 most in-demand AI engineering skill right now.

title: ML Model Deployment Pipeline
description: Take a trained ML model and build a complete production deployment pipeline with FastAPI serving, Docker containerisation, and automated testing.
objective: Bridge the gap between model training and production deployment.

milestones.title: Wrap a trained model in a FastAPI prediction endpoint
Write unit tests for the prediction logic
Containerise with Docker and test locally
Add logging, health checks, and error handling
Deploy to a cloud platform (AWS/GCP/Heroku)
Add model monitoring (track prediction drift)

evaluationCriteria: API responds correctly to valid and invalid inputs
Live URL accessible on the internet
expectedOutput: A live API endpoint on the internet that serves ML predictions.
portfolioValue: The #1 skill that separates ML engineers from data scientists.
